name: moviepilot-pi-agent
description: Pi-based personal agent with interchangeable UIs and MoviePilot integration

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mp-pi/contracts && npm run build -w @mp-pi/api && npm run build -w @mp-pi/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @mp-pi/contracts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mp-pi/contracts && npm run test -w @mp-pi/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mp-pi/contracts && concurrently -k 'npm run dev -w @mp-pi/api' 'npm run dev -w @mp-pi/web'
